# FirstRun Demo Video Shot Sheet

**Hook:** The dbt DuckDB guide never worked in a clean container. FirstRun found the broken step, fixed it, and proved the fix.

This sheet plans a 1:55 hero cut from three sources: DJI Action 4 footage, screen captures and motion graphics. It plans the shots only. Nothing here renders a video.

Every shot has an ID and a flag. `H` is human footage, `S` is a screen capture, and `M` is a motion graphic.

- **Stable** means the shot survives app changes. Shoot it once.
- **Re-shoot** means the shot shows FirstRun's own UI or CLI output. Shoot it again if that UI changes.

Every number below comes from the README, `hackathon.md`, the landing page or the dbt replay payload in `docs/examples/dbt.txt`. Do not add a number that is not in those files.

## The Film Follows One Real Bug for 1:55

One story runs the whole film: the dbt guide step `jafgen --years 6`. It breaks, FirstRun fixes it, a clean container proves the fix, and a PR goes upstream. The sponsor tools appear as the reasons each step worked.

| Time | Beat | On screen | Optional voiceover |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00 to 0:07 | B1 Cold open | Night desk. A terminal turns red at step 10. | None. Keyboard, then an error thud. |
| 0:07 to 0:15 | B2 The problem | Laptop lid closes. Kinetic text. | "Your quickstart is the only part of your product tested by people who leave instead of filing a bug." |
| 0:15 to 0:22 | B3 The answer | Wordmark. Enter key in slow motion. | "So I built FirstRun. Give it a docs URL." |
| 0:22 to 0:44 | B4 Break | /run stages Read, Plan, Run. Step 10 goes red. | "It plans one step per command. Every step runs in a clean container. Step 10 breaks." |
| 0:44 to 1:02 | B5 Fix and prove | The diff. Prove stage at 9/9. The reaction. | "FirstRun calls it a docs bug and patches the step. A second clean container passes 9 of 9." |
| 1:02 to 1:12 | B6 When it broke | Bisect timeline, 0.3.1 green, 0.4.6 red. | "jafgen 0.4.6 dropped the flag, 11 months before the guide shipped." |
| 1:12 to 1:25 | B7 Pull requests | Four real PR pages. Phone in hand. | "Every verified fix becomes a pull request. FirstRun opened 4 upstream." |
| 1:25 to 1:45 | B8 Three tools | neatlogs trace, Entire checkpoint, cfo.ai cash chart. | "neatlogs caught the agent inventing steps. Entire recorded every session. cfo.ai set the agent's budget." |
| 1:45 to 1:55 | B9 Close | Share popover, landing page, end card. Morning light. | "Docs that work. Literally. Replay the run at firstrun.atharvashah.com." |

The voiceover runs about 110 words, so the music carries the rest. The film also works with no voice, because the on-screen text carries every fact.

## Swap a Beat When the App Changes

Each beat is one block of shots with its own timing, so a change to the app costs one beat and never the whole film.

1. Check the `Flag` column in the shot checklist below.
2. Re-shoot only the `Re-shoot` shots inside the changed beat.
3. Keep the beat's length. Trim the new take to fit the old slot.
4. Rebuild a motion graphic only when a number in it changes.

Two changes are likely before Monday. The /run page lives on branch `site/run-overhaul` in `D:\Atharva\firstrun-run` and may not be live yet. A PR may also move from Open to Merged. A merged PR is good news, so re-shoot that page and keep it.

## Thirteen Camera Shots Put a Human in the Loop

You shoot alone, so every shot below is self-operated. Use the DJI Mimo app on your phone as the remote and the monitor.

**Night shots (B1, B2)** sell the problem. Keep the room dark and let the monitor light your face.

| ID | Shot | Mount and angle | FOV | Rate | Light | Length | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H01 | Wide of you at the desk, room dark, terminal glow | Desk clamp on a shelf, behind and to the right | Wide | 4K 50 | Monitor plus one warm lamp in the background | 3 s | B1 |
| H02 | Your face as you read the error, a slow frown | Mini tripod below the monitor edge, low angle | Narrowest | 4K 50 | Monitor as the key light | 2 s | B1 |
| H03 | Fingers typing, keys at eye level | Mini tripod on the desk, 15 cm from the keyboard | Narrowest | 4K 100 | Keyboard backlight plus monitor | 2 s | B1, B3 |
| H04 | Your hand closes the laptop lid, then the chair rolls back | Low angle, side of the desk | Wide | 4K 50 | Monitor only, so the lid kills the light | 2 s | B2 |
| H05 | Coffee mug steam on the desk at night | Timelapse mode, mini tripod, 2 s interval for 20 minutes | Wide | Timelapse | Warm lamp | 2 s | B2 |

**Run shots (B3 to B5)** match the screen captures. Film the real command so the keystrokes match the terminal.

| ID | Shot | Mount and angle | FOV | Rate | Light | Length | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H06 | POV typing `firstrun https://docs.getdbt.com/guides/duckdb` | Chest strap, camera tilted down to the keyboard | Wide | 4K 50 | Soft key at 45 degrees | 3 s | B3 |
| H07 | The Enter key, extreme close, in slow motion | Mini tripod at key height, 10 cm away | Narrowest | 4K 100 | Window daylight if you can, else the key light | 1 s | B3 |
| H08 | Over the shoulder as the steps run | Desk clamp behind your right shoulder | Wide | 4K 50 | Soft key plus the monitor | 3 s | B4 |
| H09 | You lean in toward the screen at the red step | Front, 30 degrees off axis, monitor-top clamp | Narrowest | 4K 50 | Soft key | 2 s | B4 |
| H10 | The "it passed" reaction: lean back, small fist, grin | Same as H09 | Narrowest | 4K 100 | Soft key | 2 s | B5 |

**Proof and close shots (B7, B9)** move into daylight. The light change shows that the problem is solved.

| ID | Shot | Mount and angle | FOV | Rate | Light | Length | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H11 | Phone in hand, GitHub mobile app opens PR #10149 | Overhead, clamp on a boom arm or shelf | Narrowest | 4K 50 | Window daylight | 3 s | B7 |
| H12 | Sunrise through the window, desk in the foreground | Timelapse mode, mini tripod, 5 s interval for 40 minutes | Wide | Timelapse | Natural | 3 s | B9 |
| H13 | Slow push toward the laptop with the landing page open | Handheld, RockSteady on, walk in from 1.5 m | Wide | 4K 50 | Daylight plus soft key | 3 s | B9 |

Two honesty rules apply to the human footage.

- Act the reactions, but keep the screen content real. H10 must react to the real 9/9 Prove stage.
- Film the real PR in H11. Do not stage a fake push notification. If a maintainer comments before the shoot, film that real notification instead.

## Screen Captures Come in Two Kinds, Live and Plate

A **live capture** is an OBS recording of a real click or a real terminal run. A **plate** is a 2x screenshot that HyperFrames animates later with push-ins and pans. Plates stay sharp at any crop, so prefer them for every shot where no interaction matters.

**Capture setup for every S shot:**

- Record OBS at 50 fps on a 1920x1080 canvas, to match the 50 fps timeline.
- Run Chrome full screen (F11) in a Guest profile, with browser zoom at 125%.
- Turn on Do Not Disturb. Hide the bookmarks bar, the extensions and the taskbar.
- Set the terminal to a light theme, Geist Mono at size 20, 100 columns wide.
- Take landscape plates at viewport 1920x1080 with device scale 2, which gives 3840x2160.
- Take vertical plates at viewport 432x768 with device scale 2.5, which gives exactly 1080x1920.

**Cursor rules for live captures:**

- Set the Windows pointer size to 3, so the cursor reads on a phone.
- Move in straight lines at half your normal speed.
- Rest the cursor for 0.5 s before each click.
- Park the cursor off the content when you are not clicking.

### FirstRun's Own Pages and CLI Need a Re-Shoot After Each UI Change

| ID | Source | Action and cursor | Zoom target | Kind | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S01 | Terminal: `firstrun https://docs.getdbt.com/guides/duckdb --fresh` | Type it live, press Enter, record the whole run | The step counter and the red step 10 line | Live | B3, B4 |
| S02 | `https://firstrun.atharvashah.com/run.html#ex=dbt`, Read stage | Open the page. Hold 2 s. Press the right arrow key. | The quoted docs sentence | Live | B4 |
| S03 | Same page, Plan stage | Press the right arrow key once. Hold 2 s. | The step list | Live | B4 |
| S04 | Same page, Run stage | Let the steps play. Press `j` to walk to step 10. | Step 10 turning red, `No such option: --years` | Live | B4 |
| S05 | `https://firstrun.atharvashah.com/run.html?s=10#ex=dbt` | Open the deep link. No clicks. | Step 10: the failure, the fix and the clean rerun | Plate | B4, B5 |
| S06 | Fix stage | Press the right arrow key. Hold 3 s on the diff. | `jafgen --years 6` to `jafgen 6` | Plate | B5 |
| S07 | Prove stage | Press the right arrow key. Hold 3 s. | The 9/9 fresh container result | Live | B5 |
| S08 | Docs graph stage | Click the step 10 node. The side panel opens. | The panel with the quoted sentence and the fix | Live | B6 |
| S09 | When did it break? stage | Hold 3 s. | The release timeline, 0.3.1 green and 0.4.6 red | Plate | B6 |
| S10 | What the docs assume stage | Hold 2 s. | git and Python 3.12 or later | Plate | B6, spare |
| S11 | Pull request stage | Hold 2 s. Open the Download menu. | The four files: report.md, patch.diff, pr_body.md, run.json | Live | B7 |
| S12 | Share popover | Click Share. Click Copy. Click "Copy link to this stage". | The popover and the toast | Live | B9 |
| S13 | `https://firstrun.atharvashah.com/`, hero | Scroll slowly from the hero to the film. | The chips "step 3/6 failed" and "6/6 verified" | Plate | B3, B9 |
| S14 | Landing page, "The Business Plan Found a Bug in the Agent" | Scroll to the cash chart. | Month 14 and the $0.028 cap | Plate | B8 |
| S15 | Terminal: `firstrun bisect <run> --package jafgen` | Type it live. | The last good and first bad release lines | Live | B6, spare |

S01 needs `--fresh`, because a URL tested in the last 24 hours returns the cached result. The dbt run took 18 minutes on 2026-10-10, so record all of it and speed-ramp in the edit. A fresh run can plan differently, so the replay page stays the source of truth for the story.

### External Pages Stay Stable

| ID | Source | Action and cursor | Zoom target | Kind | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S16 | `https://github.com/dbt-labs/docs.getdbt.com/pull/10149` | Scroll to the bisect comment. | The title, the +2 and -2 diff, the comment | Plate | B7 |
| S17 | `https://github.com/dbt-labs/docs.getdbt.com/pull/10150` | No clicks. | The title and the Open badge | Plate | B7 |
| S18 | `https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/2724` | No clicks. | The title and the Open badge | Plate | B7 |
| S19 | `https://github.com/accuknox/help/pull/671` | No clicks. | The title and the Open badge | Plate | B7 |
| S20 | neatlogs trace and the "planner invented a step" detection | Open the span tree, then the detection, then Investigate. | The flagged planner spans and the root cause | Live | B8 |
| S21 | `https://entire.io/gh/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/commit/3ca6f118ecb0a8915315eea27b5588dd8a7c6299` | Scroll the session slowly. | Checkpoint `01M4JGJ6NTE7YNB9Z0YW5FYVHN` | Plate | B8 |
| S22 | `https://cfo.ai/s/_u5lbrHIl9KX_JQE` | Open the cash forecast. | Cash going negative in month 14 under the old cap | Plate | B8 |

S20 needs a login. Hide your email and every API key field before you record. If a capture fails, the README screenshots in `D:\Atharva\firstrun\docs\assets\t-*.webp` work as fallback plates.

## Motion Graphics Reuse the Launch Film and Add Real Numbers

The 44-second launch film at `D:\Atharva\firstrun\docs\assets\firstrun-launch.mp4` already holds the title card, "Break. Fix. Prove." and the three tool cards. Cut those segments in rather than rebuilding them. Build the new elements with the `video-make` skill in HyperFrames.

| ID | Element | Content | Flag | Beat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M01 | Error type-on | "Step 10" then `No such option: --years`, in red | Stable | B1 |
| M02 | Kinetic quote | "tested by people who leave instead of filing a bug" | Stable | B2 |
| M03 | Wordmark | Launch film title card: FirstRun, "Docs that work (literally)." | Stable | B3 |
| M04 | Stage rail | A pill in the top left: Read, Plan, Run, Fix, Prove | Re-shoot | B4, B5 |
| M05 | Error callout | A red underline on `--years`, label "removed in jafgen 0.4.6" | Stable | B4 |
| M06 | Diff | Red line `jafgen --years 6` slides out, green line `jafgen 6` slides in | Stable | B5 |
| M07 | Number trio | "9/9 in a fresh container", "10m to first success", "$0.03 this run" | Stable | B5 |
| M08 | Bisect timeline | 0.2.1, 0.3.1 green, 0.4.6, 0.4.10, 0.4.14 red, then "11 months" | Stable | B6 |
| M09 | PR count | Four PR cards fan out, then "4 upstream docs PRs" | Stable | B7 |
| M10 | Tool triptych | Launch film "Three tools. One job each." plus one real number per tool | Stable | B8 |
| M11 | Built-with strip | Claude Agent SDK, Firecrawl, Jev from TypeSafe, Docker, as text labels | Stable | B8 |
| M12 | End card | Launch film creator card plus `firstrun.atharvashah.com` | Stable | B9 |

The real numbers for M10, one per tool:

- **neatlogs:** a detection flagged invented steps in 3 v1 runs, and commit 3ca6f11 fixed them.
- **Entire:** checkpoint `01M4JGJ6NTE7YNB9Z0YW5FYVHN` holds the session behind that fix.
- **cfo.ai:** the old $0.50 cap ran cash out in month 14, so the plan set the Scale cap to $0.028.

M07 uses the dbt run itself: `time_to_first_success_s` is 600.4 and `cost_usd` is 0.03. Verify ran 9 of 9 steps. Step 7, `dbt docs serve`, starts a server, so FirstRun skipped it on purpose.

Logos come only from `D:\Atharva\NOTES\META\Attachments\neathack\logos\`. Never redraw or recolor one. That folder holds neatlogs, Entire and cfo.ai only, so M11 uses text labels until you fetch official logos for the other four.

## Sound and Color Match the Site's Light Look

**Color.** The motion graphics use the live site tokens, which replaced the older ones in `10 Brand and Design.md`.

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Page | `#F4F5F9` | Every motion background |
| Ink | `#1D1D1F` | Headlines and captions |
| Muted | `#65656B` | Labels |
| Pass | `#1B8A3A` | Passed steps, 9/9 |
| Fail | `#C4281C` | Step 10, the removed flag |
| Accent | `#0A66D6` | Links, the cursor, the stage rail |

Type is Geist for headlines and Geist Mono for commands and numbers. Animate with the site's ease, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.

The human footage follows a color arc. B1 and B2 stay cool and dark, with white balance locked at 5600K so the monitor glows blue. From B3 on, grade bright and low in contrast, with lifted shadows and white balance at 5000K. That arc lets the light world arrive with FirstRun.

**Music.** Use one track at 100 to 110 BPM, minimal electronic with soft plucks and a sub pulse.

1. Play a low pad with no drums from 0:00 to 0:15.
2. Drop the beat on the wordmark at 0:15.
3. Cut all sound for 0.5 s before the step 10 error, then hit the error thud.
4. Lift the track on the 9/9 reveal near 0:58.
5. Resolve on the end card at 1:52.

Duck the music 12 dB under the voiceover. The `video-edit` render normalizes the mix to -14 LUFS.

**Sound effects.** Record the keyboard with the Action 4 mic during H03 and H06, because real keys beat a library clack. Add a soft thud for the red step, a short chime for 9/9, and one notification ping in B7. Keep whooshes off the cuts, because the Apple look cuts hard on the beat.

**Captions.** Burn them in, because most people watch muted. Use Geist 600 in ink on a white pill, 2 lines at most, in the lower third. For the vertical cut, raise them about 90 px, because the Shorts interface covers the bottom.

**Transitions.** Use match cuts. The H07 Enter press cuts to S01 on the same frame the command runs. The H09 lean-in cuts to the red step 10. The H13 push toward the laptop dissolves into the S13 landing page plate.

## The Action 4 Shoots Everything at 50 Frames per Second

India runs on 50 Hz power, so room LEDs flicker on camera at 30, 60 and 120 fps. Shoot at 50 and 100 fps with a 1/100 shutter, and the flicker disappears. Edit on a 50 fps timeline, so 100 fps footage plays at half speed.

| Setting | Value | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Resolution | 4K 16:9 | A center crop of 1215x2160 covers the 1080x1920 vertical cut |
| Normal rate | 50 fps | Matches the timeline and the 50 Hz lights |
| Slow motion rate | 100 fps | 2x slow on a 50 fps timeline |
| Shutter | 1/100 in Pro mode | Removes LED flicker at both rates |
| ISO | Cap at 1600 | Keeps night shots clean |
| White balance | Locked, 5600K at night, 5000K by day | Stops the color from drifting between takes |
| Color profile | Normal | Needs no grading time. Use D-Log M only if you will grade it. |
| Stabilization | RockSteady for H13, off on the tripod | A fixed shot needs no crop |
| FOV | Wide or the narrowest the menu offers | Ultra Wide bends the desk edges |

Frame every shot with the action in the middle third. Then one take serves both the landscape and the vertical cut.

Keep 4K 100 takes under 3 minutes. Long high-rate takes heat the camera indoors.

**Gear list:**

- [ ] DJI Action 4 with a clean lens cover
- [ ] 3 charged batteries and the charging case
- [ ] microSD card, V30 or faster, 128 GB or more, formatted in the camera
- [ ] Magnetic quick-release mount and the 1/4 inch adapter
- [ ] Chest strap mount for H06
- [ ] Desk clamp for H01, H08, H09, H10 and H11
- [ ] Mini tripod for H02, H03, H05, H07 and H12
- [ ] Phone with DJI Mimo paired as a remote and monitor
- [ ] Soft key light or a desk lamp with a diffuser
- [ ] White card or a white wall to bounce the light
- [ ] Warm practical lamp for the night background
- [ ] Gaffer tape and a microfiber cloth
- [ ] Coffee mug, a clean desk, and the same shirt for every take

## Tick Every Shot Off on Shoot Day

Name each file by shot ID and take, such as `H07_enter-slowmo_t2.mp4`. Then the edit finds every shot by ID.

## The Toolchain Can Build Every Element on This Sheet

Each skill owns one part of the edit, so the shoot can start before the app is final.

| Job | Skill | What it does here |
|---|---|---|
| Plates and site capture | `product-launch-video` | `hyperframes capture` takes 2x plates, then pans over them |
| Motion graphics M01 to M12 | `video-make` | HyperFrames compositions, rendered to MP4 |
| Assembly, grade, captions | `video-edit` engine B | An EDL cuts H, S and M clips, grades, burns captions, and sets -14 LUFS |
| Voiceover cleanup | `video-edit` tic removal | Cuts fillers and retakes from the voice take |
| Vertical cut | `video-edit` | Same EDL, 9:16 crop, captions raised about 90 px |

Put all footage in one project folder: `D:/Atharva/video-studio/video-projects/firstrun-demo/assets/`. Use one subfolder each for `human`, `screen` and `plates`.

The vertical cut runs about 45 seconds from B1, B4, B5, B7 and B9.

The submission rule asks the demo to cover architecture, implementation, runtime, reasoning and result for neatlogs, Entire and cfo.ai. B8 gives each tool about 6 seconds, which shows the result and little else.

Cut a second, judge version of up to 3:00 from the same shots. Expand B8 with the tool beats in [13 Video Production](13%20Video%20Production.md), and reuse S20, S21 and S22 at full length. The 1:55 hero cut stays the version for X and LinkedIn.

## Three Launch Films Show What to Borrow

Search each title on YouTube and watch it once before the shoot.

- **Apple, "Introducing Apple Vision Pro" (June 2023).** Borrow the restraint: one idea per shot, bright backgrounds, slow push-ins.
- **The Browser Company, "Arc Search" and its Browse for Me demo (January 2024).** Borrow the real hand on a real device, cut against crisp UI, and one moment shown once.
- **GitHub, the Copilot Workspace announcement (April 2024).** Borrow the full path from task to pull request, with no step skipped.

## Swap a Beat When the App Changes

Each beat is one block of shots with its own timing, so a change to the app costs one beat and never the whole film.

1. Check the `Flag` column in the shot checklist below.
2. Re-shoot only the `Re-shoot` shots inside the changed beat.
3. Keep the beat's length. Trim the new take to fit the old slot.
4. Rebuild a motion graphic only when a number in it changes.

Two changes are likely before Monday. The /run page lives on branch `site/run-overhaul` in `D:\Atharva\firstrun-run` and may not be live yet. A PR may also move from Open to Merged. A merged PR is good news, so re-shoot that page and keep it.

## Screen Captures Come in Two Kinds, Live and Plate

A **live capture** is an OBS recording of a real click or a real terminal run. A **plate** is a 2x screenshot that HyperFrames animates later with push-ins and pans. Plates stay sharp at any crop, so prefer them for every shot where no interaction matters.

**Capture setup for every S shot:**

- Record OBS at 50 fps on a 1920x1080 canvas, to match the 50 fps timeline.
- Run Chrome full screen (F11) in a Guest profile, with browser zoom at 125%.
- Turn on Do Not Disturb. Hide the bookmarks bar, the extensions and the taskbar.
- Set the terminal to a light theme, Geist Mono at size 20, 100 columns wide.
- Take landscape plates at viewport 1920x1080 with device scale 2, which gives 3840x2160.
- Take vertical plates at viewport 432x768 with device scale 2.5, which gives exactly 1080x1920.

**Cursor rules for live captures:**

- Set the Windows pointer size to 3, so the cursor reads on a phone.
- Move in straight lines at half your normal speed.
- Rest the cursor for 0.5 s before each click.
- Park the cursor off the content when you are not clicking.

## The Action 4 Shoots Everything at 50 Frames per Second

India runs on 50 Hz power, so room LEDs flicker on camera at 30, 60 and 120 fps. Shoot at 50 and 100 fps with a 1/100 shutter, and the flicker disappears. Edit on a 50 fps timeline, so 100 fps footage plays at half speed.

| Setting | Value | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Resolution | 4K 16:9 | A center crop of 1215x2160 covers the 1080x1920 vertical cut |
| Normal rate | 50 fps | Matches the timeline and the 50 Hz lights |
| Slow motion rate | 100 fps | 2x slow on a 50 fps timeline |
| Shutter | 1/100 in Pro mode | Removes LED flicker at both rates |
| ISO | Cap at 1600 | Keeps night shots clean |
| White balance | Locked, 5600K at night, 5000K by day | Stops the color from drifting between takes |
| Color profile | Normal | Needs no grading time. Use D-Log M only if you will grade it. |
| Stabilization | RockSteady for H13, off on the tripod | A fixed shot needs no crop |
| FOV | Wide or the narrowest the menu offers | Ultra Wide bends the desk edges |

Frame every shot with the action in the middle third. Then one take serves both the landscape and the vertical cut.

Keep 4K 100 takes under 3 minutes. Long high-rate takes heat the camera indoors.
